versionFieldNote: allowlistVersion is machine-checked: extraction/verify_all.py fails if it differs from tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json. repositoryVersion and pageSpecVersion are documentation-only, hand-maintained markers that nothing checks automatically.
sourceStack: Documentation only: React 18.3 + Vite 5.4, Tailwind CSS 3.4 (CommonJS config), custom CSS, framer-motion 14.5, Lenis 1.3 smooth scroll, react-router-dom 6.28 (versions from the installed packages at extraction). Never used for token names, section ids, schema fields or validator logic.
subject: Design system of a real, live company's marketing site, reproduced with entirely original placeholder content for the fictional product Kestrel (fictional customers, people, pricing and quotes).
constraints: No outbound requests from content: no third-party embeds, scripts, trackers or external links (the only external fetch in the clone is the Google Fonts stylesheet/files).
Forms never submit anywhere; every form resolves to a local success state.
Fonts: Fraunces, Inter, Rethink Sans 600 only (SIL OFL). The original's commercial faces are not licensed for use.
Copy, names, prices, stats and quotes: Kestrel placeholder content only; nothing from the original site.
structurallyUnusual: The original's WebGL scenes and Rive/video tiles are approximated by CSS/SVG stand-ins and static illustration panels; these are documented as stand-ins (evidenceLevel css-standin), not measured motion.
27 files (10 in public/assets/decor, 17 in public/assets/icons) originate from the original site: asset roles decor.legacy-original / icon.legacy-original, replace before sharing.
/__primitives is a dev-only showcase and is excluded from templates.
/glossary/<slug> term links intentionally render the 404 page; there is no term template.
The original's hidden 'AI Agent Instructions' text layer was deliberately not reproduced and is not a section.
ia.json marks 6 templates as planned; all six are built and routed. Disagreements are listed in extraction/measured-values.json corrections and in each template's iaJsonDiff.
